newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures slip after spot expires lower.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures slip after spot expires lower.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended lower across the board on Friday, with the spot December contract expiring sharply lower on heavy long liquidation, traders said.
The spot December contract expired at noon, down 6.9 yen at 133.1 yen per kg, with 526 lots of deliveries. The other months were 1.0 to 2.5 lower, with benchmark May off 1.3 at 146.8 yen.
December's unexpectedly low price at the expiry was due to larger-than-expected deliveries and a dearth of takers. Fresh buying in distant months later in the day cut the early losses.
The market will be closed Monday for a national holiday.
